name: memoryduel-web
description: MemoryDuel — 记忆对决站（Vite MPA + 发布阶段开关）

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check-css-comments.mjs && vite build && node scripts/copy-legacy.mjs && node scripts/filter-sitemap.mjs
scripts.build:beta: VITE_SHOW_BETA=1 tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check-css-comments.mjs && VITE_SHOW_BETA=1 vite build && VITE_SHOW_BETA=1 node scripts/copy-legacy.mjs && VITE_SHOW_BETA=1 node scripts/filter-sitemap.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/battle-sw-quiz-lang.test.mjs tests/p1-4-share-card.test.mjs tests/p1-5-color-duel.test.mjs tests/p2-new-games.test.mjs tests/quiz-lang-detect.test.mjs
